avia.window_normal_note: CAD face normal (0,-0.98481,0.17365) = exactly 10 deg toward the nose
avia.origin_note: Point-cloud origin taken at the window centroid (same convention as vkuss_vill_v4.yaml). model://livox_avia mesh registration puts its origin 4.32 mm behind the window (native [-4.32,-1.67,-0.30] in its own mesh axes); set origin_offset_native_mm=[-4.32,0,0] to follow it on-axis.
avia.orientation_note: Native Y = body left (61.2 mm housing width lies along body Y in the P4 CAD), Z toward the nose, matching the real-flight /livox/imu check. Do NOT reuse the housing-registration roll of firefighter_P3 / porter_D2: model://livox_avia mesh is rolled 90 deg about its optical axis.
